We conduct a human evaluation to assess how StreamHover compares to strong extractive and abstractive baselines. Each evaluator is asked to select the best and worst of the summaries according to each of these criteria: Fluency/Coherence: is the summary well-presented, grammatically correct and easy to read? Informativeness: does the summary provide useful information about the video clip? Overall Quality: is the summary of good quality considering both content and linguistic aspects?
